overall_summary: Hotter than expected CPI data and ongoing Bitcoin ETF outflows are weighing on risk assets including crypto. Traders should watch for more volatility around today's PPI release and any follow through selling.

items.title: House Democrats Push Back on GOP Crypto Tax Bill
items.summary: During a House Ways and Means Committee hearing, Democrats raised concerns over proposed tax treatments for staking and mining rewards, signaling delays in bipartisan progress on crypto tax clarity. This keeps regulatory uncertainty high for the sector. Traders should note that slower legislative progress removes a potential near term catalyst for institutional adoption.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs See Continued Heavy Outflows in June
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have shed over $2.1 billion so far in June amid the broader market selloff, following a record multi billion dollar outflow streak that only briefly paused. BlackRock's IBIT has been among the hardest hit. Persistent selling pressure from these products signals weakening institutional demand and adds downside risk for Bitcoin prices.

items.title: May CPI Comes in Hotter, Boosts Rate Hike Odds
items.summary: The May CPI print showed inflation at a three year high with headline figures above expectations, increasing the odds of Federal Reserve rate hikes. This pressures risk assets broadly including Bitcoin and equities. Crypto traders should expect tighter liquidity conditions to weigh on prices in the near term.
items.impact: Reduces odds of near term monetary easing

items.title: PPI Data Release Today Adds to Inflation Focus
items.summary: Markets are watching the May PPI print due out this morning for further clues on producer level price pressures ahead of next week's FOMC meeting. Hotter readings would reinforce the hawkish tilt from yesterday's CPI. This keeps macro uncertainty elevated for crypto positioning.
